text: Post-epic hardening complete. Review found one reachable regression gap and one clarity fix: LNA discovery now reports malformed .lna.h5 filename entities as ArchiveError/ScanFailed instead of silently ignoring them, with a regression for duplicate filename entities; DatasetTimeAxis.blockFor now reports negative unsafe indices as NegativeIndex for consistency, and the public partitionsForInts negative-path regression is covered. Verification: sbt datasetJVM/test datasetJS/test passed (45 JVM, 31 JS); downstream sbt modelJVM/test modelJS/test fitJVM/test fitJS/test mvpaDatasetJVM/test mvpaDatasetJS/test groupJVM/test groupJS/test passed; repository-wide sbt testAll passed; git diff --check passed over dataset/model/docs/build.
